identity: A form control for entering or choosing a date, time, date range, month, week, or duration.

scenarios.name: calendar
scenarios.screen: An empty date field sits beside its label. Its month picker is closed.
scenarios.scene: The picker is open on the target month, with no day selected.
never: A closed, non-inline picker showing its day grid on the page
Two months displayed side by side
A time dial beside the date field

arrangements.text: The label sits above the date field, and the opened picker sits directly below the field.
The label sits to the left of the field, and the month grid sits below the field throughout the task.
The label sits above the field, and the opened picker places month and year menus above the day grid.

scenarios.hint: Show an application-drawn calendar open at the target month/year with correct weekday alignment and all real dates. Target date remains unselected.

scenarios.name: typed
scenarios.screen: A labeled, empty date text field shows the locale's date-format placeholder. There is no picker panel.
never: An open calendar grid
Separate day, month, and year boxes
A date already typed into the field

arrangements.text: The label sits above one date field.
The label sits to the left of one date field, with other form rows above and below it.
The label sits above a single field whose placeholder is a written month-and-day example.

scenarios.name: segmented
scenarios.screen: One labeled date control contains three empty day, month, and year segments in locale order, with separators between them. Up and down buttons sit at the field's edge.
never: A calendar popup
A fourth date segment
All three segments filled with the target date

arrangements.text: The label sits above the segmented field, and the up and down buttons sit on its right edge.
The label sits to the left of the segmented field, with other form rows above and below it.

scenarios.name: time
scenarios.screen: A labeled time control shows one of these forms: hour and minute spinners with AM and PM, a closed three-column picker, a 24-hour text field, or a closed clock-face picker. The dropdown form shows three unset selectors for hour, minute, and AM or PM.
scenarios.scene: The columns picker is open with nothing chosen; the dropdown form has all three selectors unset.
never: The columns popup and clock face open together
A minute choice of 60
A date calendar attached to the time control

arrangements.text: The label sits above the hour and minute spinners, with AM and PM beside them.
The label sits above one field, and the opened picker places hour, minute, and AM or PM columns side by side below it.
The label sits to the left of three adjacent hour, minute, and AM or PM dropdowns.
The label sits above one field, and the opened clock face sits below it with its time header above the dial.

scenarios.hint: Show readable hour, minute and AM/PM controls or text fields with an initial value different from the requested time. Preserve AM/PM.

scenarios.name: range
scenarios.screen: Labeled start and end date fields are empty. Their two-month range picker is closed.
scenarios.scene: The range picker is open on the target start month, with no dates selected; the split-calendar form opens both calendars on that month.
never: A non-inline range picker open on load
Three or more month grids in the picker
A completed range highlighted before either date is chosen

arrangements.text: The start field sits to the left of the end field, and the opened two-month picker sits below them.
The start and end fields stack vertically, with the two-month picker visible beneath them throughout the task.
The start field sits above its own calendar, and the end field sits above a separate calendar to its right.

scenarios.hint: Show two labeled start/end date controls and readable calendar month views. Start and end remain unset.

scenarios.name: duration
scenarios.screen: A labeled duration control shows either hour and minute spinners, two number fields, or preset choices with minus and plus buttons. The control has no popup.
never: A calendar grid
An AM or PM selector
A clock-face popup
A range with start and end dates

arrangements.text: The label sits above adjacent hour and minute spinners.
The label sits to the left of separate hour and minute number fields, with other form rows around them.
The label sits above a row of preset choices, with minus and plus buttons beside the current duration.

scenarios.name: month
scenarios.screen: An empty, labeled month field is visible. Its panel of twelve months is closed.
never: A month panel open on load
A day-by-day calendar grid
A selected month already shown in the field
More than twelve month choices in one year

arrangements.text: The label sits above the month field, and the opened panel places the year and arrows above a four-column, three-row month grid.
The label sits to the left of the month field, with other form rows above and below it; the opened month panel sits beneath the field.

scenarios.name: week
scenarios.screen: An empty, labeled week field is visible. Its one-month calendar is closed.
never: A week calendar open on load
Two month grids displayed together
A week already highlighted
A list of numbered weeks replacing the day grid

arrangements.text: The label sits above the week field, and the opened month grid sits below the field.
The label sits to the left of the week field, with other form rows above and below it; the opened month grid sits beneath the field.
